name: Andhra Pradesh Mee Kosam (Citizen Grievance Redressal)
description: Chief Minister Office grievance portal for all civic infrastructure, municipal roads, streetlights, sanitation, and departmental complaints in Andhra Pradesh.
procedure: 1. Dial 1902 or login with Aadhaar. 2. File civic grievance with photo and location. 3. Track resolution with unique SMS Grievance ID.
requiredDocs: Phone Number, Aadhaar Number, Location Details, Problem Photograph

name: CPGRAMS - Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System
description: Government of India 24x7 online portal for lodging grievances against Central Ministries, Departments, and National Public Utilities.
procedure: Register at pgportal.gov.in, select concerned Ministry/Department, enter complaint details and submit for official tracking.
requiredDocs: Identity details, complaint description, evidence photos

name: Guntur Municipal Corporation (GMC)
description: Civic administration for Guntur city overseeing public roads, stormwater drains, municipal water pipelines, garbage collection, and streetlighting.
procedure: Submit complaint via GMC grievance toll-free number 1800-425-0099 or online portal with ward details and photograph.
requiredDocs: Ward number, locality name, photo of civic damage

name: Vijayawada Municipal Corporation (VMC)
description: Civic authority for Vijayawada handling municipal water supply, road repairs, pothole filling, underground drainage, and streetlights.
procedure: Lodge grievance at ourvmc.org or call civic helpline 1800-425-5001.

name: Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation (GVMC)
description: Civic governing body for Visakhapatnam urban area managing city roads, water pipelines, sanitation, solid waste, and coastal drainage.
procedure: Register via GVMC Citizen App or website grievance portal, or dial 1800-425-00009.

name: Andhra Pradesh Roads & Buildings Department (PWD)
description: State department responsible for State Highways, Major District Roads (MDR), highway potholes, bridge maintenance, and public infrastructure.
procedure: Report highway or major public road damages through Mee Kosam (1902) or submit written representation to Executive Engineer (R&B).
requiredDocs: Highway name/number, kilometre stone, landmark, photograph

name: Rural Water Supply & Sanitation Department (RWSS AP)
description: Responsible for community drinking water distribution pipelines, public tap leakages, borewells, and village sanitation in rural and peri-urban AP.
procedure: Lodge complaint on RWSS toll-free 1800-425-1877 or Mee Kosam (1902) stating village/mandal and pipeline location.
requiredDocs: Village, Mandal, Landmark of pipeline burst/leak
slaDays: 24 hours for pipeline bursts, 5 days for pump repairs

name: APCPDCL - Central Power Distribution Corporation of AP
description: Distributes electrical power across Central AP. Handles street transformer blowouts, high voltage lines, damaged utility poles, and public street power cuts.
procedure: Call 1912 (24x7) with location or submit complaint online.
requiredDocs: Service Number or Pole Number, Street Address
slaDays: 2 hours for sparks/hazards, 24 hours for breakdown

name: APEPDCL - Eastern Power Distribution Corporation of AP
description: Covers North and East AP power distribution. Handles fallen poles, transformer fire, damaged public streetlights, and power line faults.
requiredDocs: Consumer number or street pole ID, landmark

name: APSPDCL - Southern Power Distribution Corporation of AP
description: Handles electricity grid, fallen high tension wires, transformer leaks, and street power infrastructure across Southern and Rayalaseema districts.
procedure: Call 1912 immediately for hazardous live wires or register online.
requiredDocs: Pole number, street name, photo if safe
